# Lofi Memory

Lofi Memory is a cozy browser space for no-download relaxing games, lofi radio, private journaling, mood tracking, notes, reminders, memories, and calm daily reflection.

## Keyword clusters
- Private online diary, online diary with lock, private journal app, daily journaling app, mood tracker journal, journal prompts for self discovery
- Cozy browser games, relaxing browser games, no download browser games, games to play when bored, relaxing games with music
- Solitaire online, Minesweeper online, Snake game online, Wordle online, Sudoku online, Typing test online
- Lofi radio online, lofi music for studying, focus music, chill music, lofi music room for writing
